method: Visualises the already-sourced campus-grade coordinate on the CERN Meyrin site record (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim result for 'CERN - Site de Meyrin', osm_id 27005) as a single point; no new coordinate is derived here. Accuracy matches that record's own precision (500 m). No Overpass search ('Meyrin' landuse, bounding boxes 46.18-46.29 / 5.99-6.12; checked 2026-09-18) found a distinct Meyrin-site boundary polygon comparable to way 23722021 for Prévessin, so this marker, not a boundary, stands in for the Meyrin site on the map.
name: CERN Meyrin site (reference marker)

summary.plain: An approximate reference point for CERN's main Meyrin site, Switzerland; not a surveyed boundary.
